name: session-stop-releases-two-held-paths
description: KTD-11 end-of-turn release with grants held, pinned on both backends as they answer today: the session takes EXCLUSIVE on two tracked paths (preflight pre-edits, plan.md first, then CLAUDE.md), then stops; both grants are released and released_artifacts lists them in the order they were acquired, which is not name order -- both backends read the held grants with an unordered SELECT that walks the agent_states(agent_id) index, and a list compares element by element, so this row pins today's order too. This is the baseline the targeted grant handoff (#185) starts from: a stop that is not a clean success may later answer per grant, but this clean one must keep these bytes. The session claims a principal on Python (the claim is scoped, since Node answers 404) and presents it on the pre-edits and the stop, all require-class; Node issues none, so the harness omits the header there. The empty-list case is 05-session-stop-no-grants.
